tasks.DefineProblem: Understand and define the problem to be solved by the function, including edge cases such as single-character strings and multiple occurrences of characters.
tasks.DesignAlgorithm: Design an algorithm that minimizes the length of a string by removing occurrences of only one character, considering different scenarios.
tasks.ImplementFunction: Write the Python function based on the designed algorithm, ensuring it handles all specified cases.
tasks.TestFunction: Run tests to ensure the function works as expected, including edge cases and typical scenarios.
